description: Turn on AUTOMATIC blog syndication: Hermoso republishes the brand's blog posts on dev.to and/or Hashnode by itself, each with its canonical URL, one at a time and spaced through the day (perDay, default 4, at most 10). Give feedUrl (the blog's RSS or Atom feed: every post published AFTER syndication is switched on goes out) and/or queue (blog post URLs to publish first, in that order: the way to bring over older posts, best first). Posts already on the platform are skipped. Free; it needs the platform connected. on:false pauses it. With platforms including linkedin_page, each NEW post in the feed is also queued as a native post on the brand's LinkedIn company Page (linkedinOrganizationId; a short summary in the brand's voice plus the link) in the next free weekly slot (linkedinDays, default Mon/Wed/Fri; linkedinTime, default 15:15 UTC). Writing a summary is billed at the writing model's own token cost for that article and needs 2 credits available; when credits are short it uses the article's own description, at no charge.

aiDisclosure.description: dev.to’s AI-use label for every post

appendQueue.description: add to the queue instead of replacing it

brand.description: WHICH PROFILE the post lives in, for THIS CALL ONLY: an id or exact name from list_brands, needed when it was published in a profile this connection is not pinned to. A name that matches no profile, or two, is REFUSED and nothing is done.

feedUrl.description: RSS or Atom feed of the blog

footer.description: a sentence added after “Originally published at …”, e.g. what the brand does

linkedinDays.description: linkedin_page: weekdays for the slots, e.g. ["mon","wed","fri"] (default)

linkedinOrganizationId.description: linkedin_page: the company Page id from list_linkedin_pages (defaults to the only shared Page)

linkedinTime.description: linkedin_page: slot time HH:MM in UTC, default 15:15

perDay.description: 1 to 10 posts a day per platform, default 4

platforms.description: default both connected blog platforms (devto, hashnode); name linkedin_page to add the LinkedIn company Page

queue.description: post URLs to publish first, in order

runNow.description: send the next post now, within today’s budget, instead of waiting for the next pass

tags.description: tags added after the ones read off each title

name: set_blog_syndication
title: Set up automatic blog syndication
